ns0:problem.ns0:para: Use the mapping of the relation shown to ⓐ list the ordered pairs of the relation ⓑ find the domain of the relation ⓒ find the range of the relation.

ns0:media.alt: This figure shows two table that each have one column. The table on the left has the header “Name” and lists the names “Maria”, “Arm and o”, “Cynthia”, “Kelly”, and “Rachel”. The table on the right has the header “Birthday” and lists the dates “January 18”, “March 15”, “November 6”, and “December 8”. There is one arrow for each name in the Name table that starts at the name and points toward a date in the Birthday table. The first arrow goes from Maria to November 6. The second arrow goes from Arm and o to a January 18. The third arrow goes from Cynthia to December 8. The fourth arrow goes from Kelly to March 15. The fifth arrow goes from Rachel to November 6.

ns0:solution.ns0:para: ⓐ (Maria, November 6), (Arm and o, January 18), (Cynthia, December 8), (Kelly, March 15), (Rachel, November 6) ⓑ {Maria, Arm and o, Cynthia, Kelly, Rachel} ⓒ {November 6, January 18, December 8, March 15}
